description: Without signing in: a basic six-step workflow for reading a symbol's board with these tools. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: a basic six-step workflow for reading a symbol's board with these tools. With a QuantGeeks plan: the complete workflow, with every check before calling a level or a setup. A step-by-step workflow to follow when reading a symbol's board: which QuantGeeks tools to call in which order (active levels, the SPX, SPY and QQQ ladders as a committee, node history, the expiration map, readings and regime reads) and which rules to apply to what they return. It returns instructions, not data and not a verdict: call the tools it names, then apply the rules. Optional symbol, default SPX.
name: quantgeeks_read_the_board
title: Board-reading workflow
